title: Remember what the player did
blurb: The president says one thing the first time and something else when you come back.
how: A flag is a short name your island writes down, like "met". Once it's written, it stays for the rest of the game.
yield set_flag("met") writes it down. flags = yield get("flags") gives you the list of everything your island has written so far.
if "met" in flags: asks whether that name is on the list. The first time it isn't, so the lines at the bottom run. After that it is, so the lines at the top run.
return stops the function right there, so the first-time lines don't also run.
On the Try page the game starts as a new player every time you press Run, so the flags are gone again. Talk twice in the same run to see both.
try: Talk to the president twice without pressing Run in between. Then change both lines to your own.
Add a third stage. Set a second flag the second time, and check for it first.
Mix it with a choice. Ask a question the first time, save the answer with a flag like "likes-pizza", and bring it up the second time.
breaks: It says the first-time line every time
The set_flag line is missing, or it sits after a return and never runs.
It says the second line the very first time
The names don't match. "met" and "Met" are different flags.
